debugserver = subprocess.Popen([debugserver_path] + ["--kill-on-error","--no-stdio","--unix-socket","/tmp/j-pair42-a1-11852/port","--","127.0.0.1:0","/var/folders/60/fkw4vxts4p1g7rvpdh06k19r0000gn/T/tint-test262-image-j1jj0t/test","0"], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=debugserver_output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
open("/tmp/j-pair42-a1-11852/debugserver-pid", 'w').write(str(debugserver.pid))
port_connection, _ = port_socket.accept()
